Q: Error when checking Java version: could not find java.dll A:

For me it was the Windows user name which wasn't in English. once I switched to an all-English user name the Java path sorted out. I am guessing that something in the Minecraft Launcher it uses a command line which doesn't support wstring, only string.

Cheers.

Q: Docker "protocol not available" after context change A:

If you’re seeing a "panic: runtime error" or "protocol not available" when running Docker in WSL2, it usually means your terminal can't auto-locate the Docker Desktop engine socket. You can fix this permanently by forcing the CLI to use the correct Unix bridge with the following command:

echo 'export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock' >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc

Q: When using two filters in a cell array, an error is raised when a filter has no matches A:

all you need nowadays is:

=VSTACK( 
 FILTER(General!A6:C, SEARCH("Kevin's Credit", General!D6:D), 
 FILTER(General!K6:M, SEARCH("Kevin's Credit", General!N6:N))
